title: Development Lead
description:
**Company Description:**

Fusion Innovative is a technology solutions provider based in Chennai. We specialize in delivering powerful and adaptable digital solutions that help businesses succeed in the digital age. Our comprehensive services cover all aspects of technology, providing a one\-stop solution for our clients' technological needs.

**Job Description:**

We are seeking an experienced Development Lead with over 12\+ years of industry experience and a strong background in both frontend and backend technologies. As a Development Lead, you will be responsible for overseeing the entire software development process, from conception to deployment. You will lead a team of developers, guiding them in the design, development, and implementation of high\-quality software solutions. Your expertise in frontend technologies such as React, backend technologies including PHP and Node.js, as well as your proficiency in database management, API development, and server handling, will be instrumental in driving the success of our projects.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead and mentor a team of developers, providing technical guidance and support throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to define project requirements, objectives, and timelines.
* Design, develop, and implement scalable and maintainable software solutions using frontend technologies like React and backend technologies such as PHP and Node.js.
* Oversee database design and management, including MySQL DB and MongoDB, ensuring data integrity, security, and performance.
* Develop and maintain RESTful APIs to facilitate seamless communication between frontend and backend systems.
* Handle server infrastructure, including deployment, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Conduct code reviews to ensure adherence to coding standards, best practices, and performance optimization techniques.
* Stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends, evaluating their potential impact on our projects and recommending innovative solutions.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and QA engineers, to deliver high\-quality software products on time and within budget.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives, identifying areas for process optimization, automation, and efficiency gains.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum of 8\+ years of experience in software development, with at least 4 years in a leadership or managerial role.
* Strong proficiency in frontend technologies such as React, including Redux or similar state management libraries.
* Expertise in backend technologies, including PHP and Node.js, with a focus on building scalable and performant web applications.
* Extensive experience with database management systems, including MySQL DB and MongoDB, with a deep understanding of database design, optimization, and administration.
* Proven track record of designing and developing RESTful APIs using frameworks like Express.js or Laravel.
* Hands\-on experience with server handling, including deployment automation, load balancing, and performance tuning.
* Solid understanding of software development methodologies, including Agile and DevOps practices.
* Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving abilities and a proactive approach to identifying and addressing technical challenges.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹600,000\.00 \- ₹1,200,000\.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* How many years of work experience do you have in software development?
* How many years of work experience do you have as a Development Lead?
* What is your current CTC?
* What is your expected CTC?
* Do you reside at Chennai, if not will you be able to relocate?

Work Location: In person

title: Product Mgr II
description:
**Product Mgr II**

**Are you passionate about shaping products that solve real customer problems and create meaningful business impact?**

**Do you enjoy collaborating with cross\-functional teams to bring innovative product features from concept to delivery?**

**About our Team**

RX Global aims to create unforgettable experiences for attendees and exhibitors through organizing events. Innovation, creativity, and collaboration drive the company to offer exceptional services to clients.


**About the Role**

The Product Manager II will own one or more product features and lead project execution. You will develop and manage product development plans, represent your feature area within a cross\-functional team, and drive solutions that address customer needs through a deep understanding of customer pain points. You will also prioritize customer issues and defects, support timely resolution, and demonstrate product progress and outcomes to key stakeholders.


**Responsibilities**

* Own one or more product features and drive product execution from concept through delivery.
* Develop and maintain product development plans aligned to customer needs and business objectives.
* Represent assigned features within cross\-functional teams and collaborate with engineering, design, and business stakeholders.
* Identify and propose new feature ideas that address customer pain points and opportunities.
* Prioritize customer issues and product defects using relevant data and customer insights.
* Support timely resolution of production issues and communicate priorities effectively.
* Lead product demonstrations for key stakeholders at program milestones.
* Contribute to the ongoing enhancement of digital and back\-office platforms supporting Sales, Marketing, and Finance functions.

**Requirements**

* Experience managing product features or products throughout the product lifecycle.
* Ability to translate customer needs into product requirements and feature enhancements.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Experience prioritizing work using customer feedback, data, and business objectives.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, including delivering product demonstrations.
* Analytical problem\-solving skills and a customer\-focused mindset.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
* Strong collaboration skills with technical and non\-technical teams.

**Work in a Way That Works for You**

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long\-term goals.


**Working Pattern**

Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.


**Working for You**

We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:


* Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents
* Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company
* Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones
* Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement
* Flexible Working Arrangement: Achieve a harmonious work\-life balance
* Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work\-related challenges
* Medical Screening: Your well\-being is a top priority
* Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support
* Long\-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment
* New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood
* Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates
* Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays

**About the Business**

RX is a global leader in events and exhibitions, leveraging industry expertise, data, and technology to build businesses for individuals, communities, and organizations. With a presence in 25 countries across 41 industry sectors, RX hosts approximately 350 events annually. RX is committed to creating an inclusive work environment for all our people. RX empowers businesses to thrive by leveraging data\-driven insights and digital solutions. RX is part of RELX, a global provider of information\-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers. For more information, visit http://www.rxglobal.com

  


**We know your well\-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click** **here** **to access benefits specific to your location.**

We are committed to providing a fair and accessible hiring process. If you have a disability or other need that requires accommodation or adjustment, please let us know by completing our Applicant Request Support Form or please contact 1\-855\-833\-5120\.

**Job Summary**
---------------

To achieve agreed individual financial and non\-financial targets by acquiring, growing, and retaining profitable Retail Banking customers within acceptable risk parameters.
  

Contribute toward achieving team’s overall target and delivering optimal portfolio return.
  

Collaborate and build effective partnerships with other RMs, team leaders, segment heads, as well as colleagues in CDD teams and partners in risk, compliance, other support functions, and product


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategy**  

• To achieve agreed individual financial and non\-financial targets by acquiring, growing and retaining profitable Retail Banking customers within acceptable risk parameters.
  

Contribute toward achieving team’s overall target and delivering optimal portfolio return.
  

Collaborate and build effective partnerships with other RMs, team leaders, segment heads, as well as colleagues in CDD teams and partners in risk, compliance, other support functions, and product


**Business**  

• Effectively generating new business – identify prospects and convert in line with the Bank’s appetite
  

• Strategically formulating account plan – provide client’s needs\-based solutions, structure appropriate credit facility, and execute various banking transactions
  

• Proactively building trusted client relationships – maintain a portfolio of active and growing customers


**Processes**  

• Drive continuous improvement of the operational efficiency and effectiveness of processes to increase the consistency of systems and processes.
  

• Support the framework for effective management of operational risks across the Business and compliance with applicable internal policies, and external laws and regulations at a global level.
  

• Support the execution of Business strategy in a safe and well\-controlled manner and on an end\-to\-end basis – incorporating infrastructure requirements and ensuring that they are fit\-for\-growth.
  

• Conduct regular and timely customer due diligence (CDD) reviews
  

• Ensure CDD profiles are error free for timely sign off
  

• Follow and comply with AML CDD policies and procedures where applicable
  

• Identify KYC issues, provide solution or escalate to line manager if necessary
  

• Ensure internal / external KYC requirements are adhered to AML CDD policies and procedures
  

• Timely handling of customer issues, complaints, and product enquiries in accordance with established procedures


**People \& Talent**  

• Embed the Group’s values and code of conduct to ensure that adherence with the highest standards of ethics, and compliance with relevant policies, processes and regulations among employees form part of the culture


**Risk Management**  

• Abide by appropriate frameworks to guarantee that business is carried out within the Group’s risk appetite and relevant risks are appropriately managed in conjunction with line managers other stakeholders.
  

• Ensure compliance with the highest standards of regulatory conduct and compliance standards and practices as defined by internal and external requirements. This includes compliance with regulations and guidelines on Sanctions, Anti\-Money Laundering (AML), and Environmental and Social Risk Management (ESRM).
  

• Abide by the Group’s values and code of conduct and foster a robust culture to ensure that adherence with the highest standards of ethics, and compliance with relevant policies, processes and regulations among employees.
  

• Ensure that Risk Management matters that are brought to the job holder’s attention are subject to direct remedial action and/or ensure adequate reporting to the relevant superiors and/or Risk Committees.
  

• Do what is right in order to avoid reputational risks and operational losses


**Governance**  

• Ensure relevant systems and controls pertaining to the role remit are in compliance with Group and Business policies, procedures, standards and codes, including those governing all Risk types, Compliance, Operational Risk, Technology and Operations, Finance and Reputation
  

• Ensure adherence with the following Regulatory Compliance policies and processes (as is applicable):
  

• Anti\-Money Laundering (AML) and all applicable money laundering prevention procedures
  

• Client Due Diligence \& Related Periodic Reviews
  

• Client Suitability Standards
  

• Treating Customers Fairly
  

• Approval \& review of Credit Applications
  

• Maintain Documentary standards
  

• Data Confidentiality
  

• Cross\-Border Policy
  

• Sanctions
  

• Environmental and Social Risk Management (ESRM)
  

• Anti\-Bribery and Corruption (ABC)
  

• Embed the Group’s values and code of conduct to ensure that adherence with the highest standards of ethics, and compliance with relevant policies, processes and regulations among employees form part of the culture
  

• Engage with all audit report findings and ensure feedback is acted upon


**Regulatory \& Business Conduct**  

• Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  

• Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  

• Lead to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles
  

• Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.


**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

• Communication
  

• Sales \& networking


**Qualifications**
------------------

• University Graduate
  

• Minimum \[4] years of relevant experience in serving business/commercial/corporate clients. Experience in servicing international businesses under the cross\-border context is a plus
  

• Excellent financial analysis skills and ability to assess client creditworthiness and key risk considerations / mitigations
  

• Sound product knowledge on trade, cash, lending and FX and strong understanding of local industries, supply/value chains and market environment
  

• Knowledge of operational procedures, documentation requirements, banking practices and regulations related to retail banking
  

• Firm in all business guidelines and compliance issues
  

• Sound knowledge of financial markets and investment products
  

• Outstanding communication and presentation skills


**About Standard Chartered**
----------------------------

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
  

  

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
  

  

Together we:
  

  

Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  

Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  

Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term


**What we offer**
-----------------

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  

  

Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  

Time\-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  

Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  

Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market\-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first\-aiders and all sorts of self\-help toolkits
  

A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  

Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies \- everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

title: Sr Manager - Technology & Platform Development
description:
Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications
  
**Job Requirements (JR):**

Senior Manager (B4\-1\) \- Secure Access Service Edge (SASE)


**Location:** Chennai


**Role Purpose**

Lead the strategy, product development, transformation, onboarding, orchestration, and engineering evolution of the Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) portfolio, encompassing SD\-WAN, Secure Service Edge (SSE) and Secure Internet Access.


The role requires deep expertise in Lead\-to\-Order (L2O), Order\-to\-Cash/Order\-to\-Billing (O2C/O2B), and Trouble\-to\-Resolve (T2R) customer journeys, service orchestration platforms, AI\-enabled automation, API\-driven ecosystems, and cloud\-native security architectures. The position will drive seamless customer onboarding, service lifecycle management, policy\-based provisioning, and Zero\-Touch MACD (Move, Add, Change, Delete) operations across the SASE portfolio while enabling scalable digital service delivery and customer experience transformation.


**Key Responsibilities**

**SASE Product Strategy \& Portfolio Management**

* Drive product strategy, portfolio evolution, onboarding, and lifecycle management for SASE services including SD\-WAN, SSE, and Secure Internet Access.
* Define and execute product roadmaps aligned with enterprise security, cloud transformation, and digital connectivity strategies.
* Lead portfolio modernization initiatives to improve customer experience, operational efficiency, automation, and service adoption.
* Partner with business, product management, security architecture, and commercial teams to develop next\-generation managed SASE offerings.

**Product Development \& Engineering Leadership**

* Own end\-to\-end telecom and security software product development, release governance, roadmap execution, and portfolio transformation.
* Lead engineering teams responsible for service onboarding, orchestration, workflow automation, and customer lifecycle management.
* Drive adoption of cloud\-native, API\-first, and microservices\-based architectures across SASE platforms.
* Ensure scalable and secure service delivery through standardized engineering and operational frameworks.

**Digital Customer Journey Transformation**

* Lead transformation initiatives across L2O, O2C/O2B, and T2R value streams for SASE products.
* Drive self\-service capabilities for provisioning, configuration management, policy deployment, service upgrades, and MACD operations.
* Improve customer onboarding, service activation, assurance, incident management, and billing experiences through automation and orchestration.
* Enhance digital channels and customer portals to support secure service consumption and lifecycle management.

**Service Orchestration \& Automation**

* Lead implementation and integration of Service Orchestration platforms, Cisco NSO, MSO, SD\-WAN controllers, and cloud security management platforms.
* Drive onboarding of SASE services onto orchestration platforms for automated fulfillment and service activation.
* Enable policy\-driven provisioning, Zero\-Touch deployment, automated configuration management, and lifecycle automation.
* Govern orchestration architectures spanning CRM, Order Management, Inventory, Security Platforms, Assurance, and Billing ecosystems.

**API \& Ecosystem Integration**

* Define API\-led integration strategies across OSS/BSS platforms, security vendors, hyperscalers, and network domains.
* Drive adoption of TM Forum Open APIs, API management frameworks, and digital ecosystem integrations.
* Lead integration initiatives involving Salesforce, ServiceNow, SAP, orchestration platforms, and security technology stacks.
* Ensure interoperability between SD\-WAN, cloud security, identity management, observability, and enterprise systems.

**AI \& Operational Excellence**

* Lead AI\-driven automation initiatives across fulfilment, assurance, security operations, and customer support functions.
* Utilize AI/ML capabilities to improve incident prediction, root cause analysis, security posture management, and operational intelligence.
* Drive automation\-led reduction in manual operational effort and improved service reliability.
* Establish KPIs and governance frameworks for automation maturity and customer experience improvements.

**Stakeholder \& Delivery Leadership**

* Collaborate with Product, Security, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and Commercial teams to drive portfolio outcomes.
* Conduct business requirement analysis, solution assessments, impact analysis, estimation, and investment planning.
* Lead leadership reviews, customer demonstrations, architecture governance, PI planning, UAT governance, and program steering committees.
* Manage strategic relationships with technology partners, vendors, and cross\-functional stakeholders.

**Required Experience \& Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or related discipline.
* 8\+ years of experience in Telecom, Networking, Cloud Security, SASE, and Software Product Engineering domains.
* Proven expertise in L2O, O2C/O2B, and T2R process transformation within telecom, networking, or managed security services environments.
* Strong experience in SASE technologies including:
* + SD\-WAN
	+ Secure Service Edge (SSE)
	+ Secure Internet Access
* Experience with service orchestration, provisioning automation, and lifecycle management platforms.
* Deep understanding of enterprise networking technologies including WAN, LAN, MPLS, Internet, Routing, Switching, SD\-WAN, and Cloud Connectivity.
* Experience in API\-first architectures, cloud platforms, automation frameworks, and AI\-enabled operational models.
* Strong exposure to OSS/BSS ecosystems and integration architectures.
* Experience leading enterprise\-scale transformation programs and customer journey modernization initiatives.

**Preferred Technical Expertise**

**SASE \& Security Technologies**

* Cisco Secure Access
* Cisco SD\-WAN (Viptela)
* Palo Alto Prisma SASE
* Netskope
* Zscaler
* Fortinet SASE
* SSE Platforms

**Networking \& Connectivity**

* SD\-WAN
* MPLS
* Routing \& Switching
* Hybrid Connectivity
* Internet \& Cloud Connectivity
* Software Defined Networking (SDN)

**Service Orchestration \& Automation**

* Zero\-Touch Provisioning
* Service Lifecycle Management
* Network Automation Frameworks

**OSS/BSS \& Digital Platforms**

* Salesforce (SFDC)
* ServiceNow
* SAP S/4HANA
* Order Management Platforms
* CRM
* Inventory, Assurance \& Billing Systems
* TM Forum Open APIs
* Open Digital Architecture (ODA)

**Cloud \& AI Technologies**

* AWS
* Azure
* Google Cloud
* Container \& Kubernetes Platforms
* AI/ML\-powered Operations
* AIOps
* Observability Platforms
* Security Analytics \& Automation

**Desirable Experience**

* Minimum 5 years as Product Owner, Engineering Manager, Digital Product Manager, or Portfolio Lead within SASE, Managed Security, SD\-WAN, Enterprise Connectivity, or Security Services domains.
* Experience with SAFe Agile delivery models including PI Planning, Release Train Management, Portfolio Governance, and Backlog Prioritization.
* Experience managing product investments, engineering budgets, business cases, and benefit realization.
* Proven experience in EPIC management, journey mapping, portfolio planning, and strategic roadmap development.
* Strong experience driving cross\-functional alignment across OSS/BSS platforms, orchestration systems, cloud environments, and security platforms.
* Experience in onboarding security services onto automated fulfilment and orchestration platforms.
* Exposure to AI\-driven security operations, AIOps, and cloud\-native service delivery environments.

**Core Competencies**

* SASE Portfolio Management \& Strategy
* Product Engineering \& Service Lifecycle Management
* SD\-WAN \& Secure Access Services
* L2O, O2C/O2B \& T2R Transformation
* Service Orchestration \& Automation
* Zero\-Touch Provisioning \& MACD Automation
* OSS/BSS Architecture \& Transformation
* Cloud Security \& Enterprise Networking
* AI \& Digital Transformation Leadership
* Portfolio Governance \& Roadmap Management
* SAFe Agile Delivery \& PI Planning
* Stakeholder \& Executive Management

**Success Measures**

* Reduction in L2O, O2C/O2B, and T2R cycle times for SASE services.
* Increased automation and straight\-through provisioning rates.
* Successful onboarding of SASE products onto orchestration and fulfilment platforms.
* Expansion of Zero\-Touch deployment and MACD capabilities.
* Improved customer onboarding, activation, and service assurance KPIs.
* Growth in SASE adoption, customer retention, and portfolio revenues.
* Increased API utilization, orchestration maturity, and operational efficiency.
* Enhanced AI\-driven operational outcomes and service reliability.
* Successful execution of portfolio roadmaps, PI objectives, and transformation initiatives.
* Improved customer experience and business outcomes across the SASE service portfolio.

description:
**About Eriez**


Eriez is a global leader in Separation Technologies and Material Handling Solutions, serving customers worldwide for more than 80 years. Our commitment to innovation, engineering excellence, and customer success has made us a trusted partner across a wide range of industries.

 **Eriez India** is looking for an experienced and dynamic **Manager – Aftermarket \& Service Line** to lead the growth and development of our aftermarket and service business.


This is a strategic role responsible for driving **aftermarket sales, service revenue, customer retention, profitability, and lifecycle value** across Eriez India’s installed customer base.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead and execute the Aftermarket \& Service Line strategy to achieve revenue, order intake, profitability, and customer satisfaction objectives.
* Drive growth across spare parts, service contracts/AMCs, refurbishment, upgrades, modernization, repairs, and lifecycle solutions.
* Develop strong relationships with key customers and identify opportunities to increase the value of Eriez's installed equipment base.
* Build a customer\-focused service organization with strong processes, systems, and performance standards.
* Lead commercial discussions, negotiations, and contract closures while ensuring appropriate margins and risk management.
* Work closely with Sales, Service, Engineering, Production, Product/Market Managers, HQ, and global affiliates to deliver excellent customer outcomes.
* Strengthen complaint resolution, customer feedback, escalation management, and overall customer experience.
* Develop and motivate the aftermarket/service team to achieve business objectives.
* Monitor market and competitor activities and identify opportunities to strengthen Eriez's aftermarket offering.
* Provide accurate sales forecasts, pipeline updates, KPIs, and business performance reports to leadership.
* Support customer commissioning, acceptance trials, technical discussions, training, and site services when required.

 **Requirements** **What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Sales/Business, with 10–15 years of relevant experience.
* Strong experience in aftermarket, service, customer service, or service sales management.
* Experience in mining, construction, minerals processing, manufacturing, or other heavy industries will be highly preferred.
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to identify and convert aftermarket opportunities.
* Proven ability to lead teams, manage key customers, and drive business growth.
* Strong customer\-focused mindset with excellent relationship\-building and negotiation skills.
* Good technical understanding and ability to prepare business cases and technical reports.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills in English and Hindi.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.
* Experience with a multinational/international organization will be an advantage.

 **Benefits** **Why Join Eriez?**

* Play a key role in building and growing Eriez India’s aftermarket and service business.
* Strengthen long\-term customer relationships and enhance customer lifecycle value.
* Drive sustainable revenue growth and contribute directly to the company’s overall profitability.
* Develop innovative aftermarket solutions and create new business opportunities.
* Competitive compensation, Profit Sharing Program, Health Insurance, and a five\-day work week

title: Senior Product Manager / Product Manager
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We are building a governed citizen\-development platform for low\-code/no\-code apps across the power, utilities, and renewables sector. As a **Senior Product Manager / Product Manager**, you will translate business goals into a clear roadmap, guide UAT, and lead training and enablement so users can deliver safely within a full lifecycle model.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate requirement discovery, analysis, and documentation with business partners and development stakeholders
* Design and deliver end\-to\-end training sessions that build business user proficiency in platform usage and best practices
* Facilitate cross\-department communication to clarify objectives and align on platform capabilities
* Align product features with changing business needs and regulatory requirements during design and development
* Lead user acceptance testing to confirm solutions meet agreed requirements and quality standards
* Partner with support and operations teams to sustain maintenance and ensure ongoing platform performance
* Manage stakeholder expectations across the lifecycle, maintaining transparency and resolving issues in a timely manner
* Improve training materials and enablement approaches based on user feedback and platform releases
* Engage with a team of 3\-5 colleagues and coordinate with third\-party vendors as needed to deliver outcomes

**Requirements**

* Hands\-on background with 10\-18 years of overall experience in IT
* Proven ability to bridge technical and business viewpoints to align platform capabilities with user requirements
* Demonstrated stakeholder management skills, balancing priorities across business and engineering teams
* Solid experience designing and delivering training programs for different user groups and skill levels
* Strong capability to convert complex business needs into clear, actionable technical specifications for development teams
* Track record of leading cross\-functional collaboration and enabling effective communication across departments
* Working knowledge of Product Management, Product Life Cycle, Product Roadmap, Product Vision, Requirement Analysis, Training and Enablement

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: CRM Manager
description:
Sportstech is looking for an experienced **CRM Manager** to own and scale our customer lifecycle, retention, and engagement strategy across multiple European markets.

You will take end\-to\-end ownership of our **email, WhatsApp, and lifecycle marketing activities**, manage our **Klaviyo setup**, and build data\-driven programs that improve customer engagement, retention, repeat purchases, and lifetime value.

A key part of the role will also be developing the subscription lifecycle strategy for the **Sportstech Live app**, covering free\-trial onboarding, trial\-to\-paid conversion, churn prevention, win\-back, and customer reactivation.

Key Responsibilities

* Own and develop the overall CRM roadmap and lifecycle marketing strategy.
* Build and optimize customer lifecycle flows, including welcome series, abandoned cart, browse abandonment, post\-purchase education and onboarding, accessory cross\-sell, win\-back, and VIP/loyalty programs.
* Develop subscription lifecycle programs for the **Sportstech Live app**, including free\-trial onboarding, trial\-to\-paid conversion, churn prevention, retention, win\-back, and reactivation.
* Expand CRM operations into new European markets, particularly **Spain and Italy**, including localized customer journeys, market\-specific flows, and compliant consent and opt\-in processes.
* Design, execute, and analyze **A/B and multivariate tests** across subject lines, send times, offers, messaging, and content.
* Build, optimize, and maintain **Klaviyo** flows, segments, campaigns, automations, and reporting.
* Collaborate with technical and web teams to ensure effective integration between CRM activities and our **Shopify** ecosystem, including tracking, product catalog, customer events, and data flows.
* Monitor and report CRM performance using key metrics such as **CTOR, click rate, conversion rate, revenue per recipient, customer lifetime value (LTV), and repeat purchase rate**.
* Track subscription\-specific metrics including **free\-trial conversion, retention, churn, and reactivation rates**.
* Maintain high standards for audience data quality, list hygiene, consent management, and email deliverability.
* Collaborate with brand and creative teams to ensure customer communications remain consistent with Sportstech's fitness\-focused, motivating, and results\-driven brand positioning.

Required Qualifications \& Experience

* Proven professional experience in **CRM, Lifecycle Marketing, Retention Marketing, or Customer Engagement**.
* Experience in **fitness, wellness, consumer hardware, e\-commerce, or a related consumer\-focused industry** is preferred.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **Klaviyo**, including flows, segmentation, campaigns, automation, A/B testing, and reporting.
* Experience with **subscription lifecycle marketing**, including trial conversion, churn prevention, retention, win\-back, and reactivation for an app or digital product.
* Experience launching or scaling CRM programs across **European markets**, including localization and country\-specific consent requirements.
* Demonstrated experience designing, executing, and interpreting **A/B and multivariate testing programs**.
* Experience marketing to customers across multiple languages and international markets.
* Familiarity with **Shopify** and its customer data model, including customer events, catalog data, and customer properties.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret CRM data, dashboards, customer behavior, and campaign performance.
* Good understanding of customer retention, segmentation, personalization, and lifecycle marketing principles.
* Interest in **fitness and wellness**, with an understanding of customer motivations such as habit\-building, goal\-setting, progress, and long\-term engagement.

Nice to Have

* Experience with **WhatsApp marketing**, including WhatsApp Business API, opt\-in compliance, and template messaging.
* Experience with **loyalty, referral, or ambassador programs**.
* Experience working with additional **email service providers (ESPs) or CRM platforms**.
* Previous experience supporting CRM activities across DACH, France, Spain, or Italy.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to take ownership of CRM and lifecycle marketing for an international fitness brand.
* Exposure to multiple European e\-commerce markets.
* Opportunity to work across both **e\-commerce and digital subscription customer journeys**.
* A role combining strategy, experimentation, data analysis, technology, and creative execution.
* Collaboration with international marketing, creative, e\-commerce, and technology teams.

description:
**Company:** BEEYOOND GAMING  
**Location:** Chennai, India  
**Department:** Performance Marketing  
**Experience:** 3\+ Years

Sportstech is strengthening its in\-house paid search team, and Microsoft Advertising is an important growth channel alongside Google Ads.

We are looking for an **Assistant Manager – Microsoft Bing Ads** who will take end\-to\-end ownership of Microsoft Advertising across key European markets, including DACH, France, Italy, and Spain.

The role will focus on building Microsoft Ads into a profitable and efficiently managed acquisition channel across **Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and Copilot placements**.

Key Responsibilities

* Own and manage **Microsoft Advertising end\-to\-end**, including Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and Copilot placements.
* Manage campaigns across multiple European markets with accountability for advertising spend and return.
* Expand Bing coverage by intelligently importing and adapting campaigns from Google Ads instead of using direct copy\-paste approaches.
* Optimize campaigns specifically for Microsoft audiences and platform behaviour.
* Manage the **Microsoft Merchant Center product feed**, including feed quality, structure, disapprovals, and optimization.
* Set and achieve performance targets across **ROAS, CPA, and KUR**.
* Manage and pace budgets across campaigns and markets.
* Manage AI Max and Copilot campaigns using the right assets, audience signals, exclusions, and advertising copy.
* Own and maintain accurate **Microsoft UET conversion tracking** and align it with the broader measurement setup.
* Run structured tests across bidding strategies, ad copy, audiences, and product\-feed variants.
* Analyse results and continuously optimize campaign performance.
* Coordinate with Google Ads owners and the Creative \& Localization team to maintain consistency across paid search channels.
* Translate campaign and performance data into clear recommendations for the Head of Performance Marketing.

Required Skills \& Experience

* **3\+ years of hands\-on paid search experience** within e\-commerce or online retail.
* Direct experience managing **Microsoft Advertising / Bing Ads**, or strong Google Ads expertise with the ability to independently manage Microsoft Ads.
* Strong understanding of **Shopping campaigns and product feeds**.
* Experience managing Merchant Center environments and product\-feed performance.
* Good knowledge of **conversion tracking, UET, GA4, bidding strategies, budget management, and paid\-search account structures**.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven approach to campaign optimization.
* Comfortable working with performance data, spreadsheets, and structured testing frameworks.
* Ability to independently manage accounts and take ownership of performance.
* Fluent English communication skills.

Nice to Have

* German language skills for the DACH market.
* Experience managing paid search campaigns across multiple European markets.
* Knowledge of **Google Ads scripts** and feed\-management tools.
* Experience importing or synchronizing accounts between Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising.
* Background in **sports, fitness, consumer goods, or e\-commerce**.

How Success Will Be Measured

Success in this role will be evaluated based on:

* ROAS, CPA, and KUR performance against targets
* Incremental volume generated through Microsoft Bing
* Growth of in\-house managed advertising spend
* Account health and campaign quality
* Product\-feed quality and stability
* Tracking accuracy and integrity
* Speed and quality of campaign testing and optimization

If you are a performance\-driven paid search professional who enjoys taking ownership of accounts, testing new opportunities, and scaling Microsoft Advertising efficiently, we would be interested in hearing from you.
